array_tutorial.name: Array Tutorial Sequence
array_tutorial.description: Progressive tutorial introducing array concepts through VR navigation
array_tutorial.qfep_connection: Arrays are pure order â€” every element at a known index, zero access entropy. The F-baseline: structure before complexity, the grid before the noise.
learning_objectives: Binary indexing, floor division, and modular arithmetic: 2 bits address a 4×4 grid; `index // width` is the row, `index % width` is the column; modular arithmetic wraps the grid into wallpaper-group symmetries.

artifact_groups.rationale: Gallery of pattern stations from simple repeat to complex tiling. Introduces array structure through visual patterns.
Minimal first interaction: one cube to grab, one exit to find. Pure intro to VR navigation.
Linear array traversal: row completion with coordinate reference.
2D array navigation: X and Y axes in a grid structure with active hazard introduction.
Vertical navigation and volumetric thinking: 3D array as spatial cube.
Pattern recognition: checkerboard indexing, wave patterns, wallpaper groups. Arrays as function: index to value.
Large reactive disco floor: audio-step interaction and spatial pattern reading. Culmination of array concepts at scale.

content: Tutorial_Disco: Reactive Disco Floor at Scale
array_tutorial.notes: 2026-05-13: discarded 26 Facade_* stubs (moved conceptually to new facade_assembly branch sequence — to be rebuilt) and 10 Pattern_pt* stubs (to be rebuilt under mosaicanalysis as wallpaper-group expression maps). All 36 had MISSING artifact tokens and no .md text. Folders on disk preserved pending explicit deletion.
array_tutorial.retired_reason: Folded into Color and Composition. Measured before retiring: 27 of its 35 artifacts already stood in color, its maps sorted onto three of the ladder's rungs (Tutorial_Single -> unit, Array/Row/2D_Build/3D -> index, Tutorial_Pattern/Array_Patterns -> rule), and the spine itself already called it 'the grid, indexing, addressable repetition'. The Array map lives on as color's index room. Five artifacts existed NOWHERE else and were rehomed first — grid_2d_4x4 into Array (the index room had no 2d at all), pattern_tile_plate into Pattern_Foundry, grid_model and standalone_disco into Color_Context_Placed, step_sequencer into the Markov chains. The eight remaining maps keep their files.
array_tutorial.deferred_reason: 2026-09-07, Palle, answering the Array brief on /spine-brief: 'revive array_tutorial with all nine maps ... Tutorial_Disco yes. Chamber_Arrays no.' The sequence was dissolved into color on 2026-08-24 as its index rung; Array is taken back out of color and the ladder is re-listed in Palle's order, which is dimensional - single, row, 2D, 3D - then pattern, then disco. Chamber_Arrays is the only one not revived: it is a catalyst chamber, not a rung of the ladder. || THE OVERTURE, 2026-09-07 (Palle: 'Array keeps the four rungs as an overture'). Array holds row_3_x, column_3_z, grid_2d_4x4 and grid_3d_4x4x4 although Tutorial_Row, Tutorial_2D_Build and Tutorial_3D now each own one of them. Deliberate: the first hall shows the whole ladder standing at once, and the seven after it take one rung each and make it walkable. Do not 'de-duplicate' this. || THE SUBSETS LEAVE, 2026-09-07 (Palle: 'but these are the artifact on array map so they should not be in the sequence'). Measured: Tutorial_Row holds 3 artifacts and Tutorial_3D holds 6, and EVERY ONE of them already stands in Array. Neither room holds a single thing the overture does not. Once Array is ruled the overture that shows the whole ladder at once, a room that is a strict subset of it is the overture seen twice, not a rung — so both leave the walk. They keep their map files. Tutorial_2D_Build is NOT dropped: it owns gridagent, the only object in the ladder that writes into an array without you. || AND 2D_BUILD TOO, 2026-09-07 (Palle: 'drop Tutorial_2D_Build too, gridagent can move to Array'). Seven of its eight artifacts were already in the overture; the eighth, gridagent — the only object in the ladder that writes into an array without you — moves to Array at (7,4), beside grid_2d_4x4. With that the room is a strict subset like Row and 3D, and leaves for the same reason. || THE UNBRAIDING, 2026-09-07 (Palle). colour was carrying two threads: a COLOUR thread (Nails, Pillar, Walls, Context_Placed) and a PATTERN thread (Pattern_Foundry, Symmetry_Seventeen), diagnosed by the red-thread pass on 2026-09-03 — 'three of the seven rooms contain no colour argument at all'. The pattern rooms leave for a sequence of their own (`tiling`), joined by Tutorial_Pattern and Array_Patterns from array_tutorial. Evidence they are one sequence: pattern_tile_mirror stands in all four, pattern_tile_4x4 in two, pattern_maker_station in two, vr_tile_editor in two. colour's stated truth — 'context, not wavelength' — now applies to every room in colour.
